treatments.Healthy: Field health is optimal. Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilization and alternate wetting and drying irrigation. No fungicide application needed.
treatments.Rice Blast: Apply Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L at early tillering and panicle emergence. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer. Bio-control: Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L.
treatments.Brown Spot: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/L at boot-leaf stage. Ensure adequate potassium and silicon nutrition to fortify epidermal cell walls.
treatments.Leaf Scald: Apply Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1.0 g/L or Benomyl 50% WP @ 1.0 g/L. Remove infected field bund weeds and maintain optimal row spacing to improve canopy airflow.
treatments.Bacterial Blight: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L combined with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L. Drain stagnant field water and delay nitrogen top-dressing until lesion expansion halts.
